templates.name: Welcome
templates.subject: Welcome to BizBuddy, {{first_name}}: your login details
templates.preheader: Your account for {{company_name}} is ready. Here’s how to sign in.
templates.sent_when: An admin creates an employee account.

templates.name: Password reset instructions
templates.subject: Reset your BizBuddy password
templates.preheader: Use this link within {{expires_in}} to choose a new password.

templates.name: Password changed
templates.subject: Security alert: your BizBuddy password was changed
templates.preheader: If this was you, there’s nothing to do.
templates.sent_when: Right after any password change or reset.

templates.name: Account deletion code
templates.subject: {{code}} is your code to delete your BizBuddy account
templates.preheader: Enter this code to confirm. Deleting your account can’t be undone.
templates.sent_when: A user starts deleting their account.

templates.name: Missed clock-in
templates.subject: You haven’t clocked in for {{shift_name}}
templates.preheader: Your shift started at {{shift_start}}. Clock in now, or tell {{#if supervisor_name}}{{supervisor_name}}{{else}}your supervisor{{/if}} if you’re off.
templates.sent_when: A scheduled shift starts with no clock-in, after the grace period.

templates.name: Missed clock-out
templates.subject: No clock-out recorded for {{shift_date}}
templates.preheader: {{#if shift_name}}Your {{shift_name}} shift ended at {{shift_end}}. {{/if}}Add your clock-out time so you’re paid correctly.
templates.sent_when: A shift ends and the employee is still clocked in, or has no clock-out.

templates.name: Clock-out reminder
templates.subject: Reminder: automatic clock-out at {{auto_clock_out}}
templates.preheader: Your shift ends at {{shift_end}}. If you’re still clocked in, we’ll clock you out at {{auto_clock_out}}.
templates.sent_when: A set time before the automatic clock-out runs.

templates.name: Automatic clock-out (employee)
templates.subject: You were clocked out automatically at {{auto_clock_out}}
templates.preheader: Check the time. If you worked a different time, send a correction{{#if correction_deadline}} by {{correction_deadline}}{{/if}}.

templates.name: Automatic clock-out (supervisor)
templates.subject: {{employee_name}} was clocked out automatically on {{shift_date}}
templates.preheader: Clock-out set by the system at {{auto_clock_out}}. Confirm the real time before approving.
templates.sent_when: The automatic clock-out runs (copy to the employee’s supervisor).

templates.name: Time log correction
templates.subject: Your time log for {{shift_date}} was corrected
templates.preheader: {{edited_by}} changed your {{field_changed}}. Check the new time.
templates.sent_when: A supervisor or admin edits an employee’s punch.

templates.name: Morning attendance report
templates.subject: Morning attendance · {{report_date}}: {{missing_count}} not clocked in
templates.sent_when: Every morning, at the time set for attendance reports.

templates.name: Evening attendance report
templates.subject: Evening attendance · {{report_date}}: {{open_count}} still clocked in
templates.sent_when: Every evening, at the time set for attendance reports.

templates.name: Website contact form (team inbox)
templates.subject: Website inquiry: {{inquirer}}
templates.sent_when: BB-145: a visitor sends the contact form on mybizbuddy.co. Goes to CONTACT_FORM_TO only, Reply-To = the visitor.
